title: AE2 GUI (Light Edition)
description: Adaptation GUI from AE2 to the basic GUI
body:
Graphic user interface replacements in AE2 style. Check out the gallery.

Use the style of Applied Energetics 2 on the basics menu, button, and text fields to have a better feeling of a unified interface style. This resource pack will not affect or enhance any world object or entity, it is focused only on the interface.

This resource pack primarily supports the [Universum](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/universum) modpack, meaning that every mod used within it will be enhanced over time. I will hear up every request to expand and adjust to any other mods, so don't hesitate to ask.
